rationale: The original short thesis relied on price holding below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($299.63) and session VWAP ($299.91), both of which have now been reclaimed across five consecutive 1-minute candles with higher lows. With buyers pressing directly against the $300.00 level on expanding volume (25k shares on the breakout bar through VWAP), the downside momentum has failed and exiting now avoids waiting for the $300.20 stop to trigger. Flipping long immediately below major $300.00 resistance offers poor risk-reward compared to moving to flat.
